fields.mechanism: Self-healing polymer coating inspired by automotive industry
fields.intervention: Implement a self-healing polymer coating on the intracranial stent that can seal micro-damage and maintain structural integrity
fields.expected_effect: Prevention of premature activation by maintaining stent function even under mechanical stress conditions that might otherwise cause deformation
fields.falsification_test: Accelerated aging testing with mechanical stress cycles to evaluate coating integrity and prevention of premature activation compared to conventional stents
fields.mechanism_source_span: "a comprehensive understanding of the mechanisms underlying stent implantation-associated pathology is essential for the development of next-generation stent platforms"

fields.mechanism: Inflammatory responses contribute to stent-associated complications
fields.intervention: Incorporate anti-inflammatory surface modifications on the intracranial stent
fields.expected_effect: Reduced inflammation at the stent site leading to decreased premature activation events
fields.falsification_test: Measure inflammatory markers and activation rates in animal models comparing standard stents with anti-inflammatory modified stents
fields.mechanism_source_span: "systematically discuss the pathological mechanisms underlying stent-associated complications from four key perspectives: endothelial cells, vascular smooth muscle cells, the coagulation system, and inflammatory responses"

fields.mechanism: Delay in reendothelialization increases the risk of late thrombotic events
fields.intervention: Surface modification of intracranial stents to promote endothelial cell adhesion and accelerate reendothelialization
fields.expected_effect: Reduced risk of premature activation by minimizing thrombotic events that could trigger stent deployment or malfunction
fields.falsification_test: In vitro endothelial cell adhesion assay comparing current stent surface with modified surface, followed by animal model testing to measure time to complete endothelial coverage
fields.mechanism_source_span: Nevertheless, drugs eluted from stents can impair endothelial recovery. This delay in reendothelialization increases the risk of late thrombotic events.

fields.mechanism: Combined fluid dynamics and surface charge modification to prevent premature activation
fields.intervention: Stent design with optimized flow patterns and electrostatic surface properties that resist protein adsorption and platelet adhesion
fields.expected_effect: Reduction in premature activation events by minimizing thrombus formation at the stent surface without compromising structural integrity
fields.falsification_test: Computational fluid dynamics modeling followed by in vitro testing in whole blood under simulated intracranial flow conditions comparing activation times between modified and standard stents
fields.mechanism_source_span: "stent systems are widely used in both cardiac and cerebrovascular interventions; however, in-stent restenosis and acute stent thrombosis associated with bare-metal stents can cause severe ischemic complications"

fields.mechanism: Delayed reendothelialization increases the risk of late thrombotic events
fields.intervention: Design intracranial stents with endothelial-promoting surface coatings that enhance reendothelialization without impairing endothelial function
fields.expected_effect: Reduced risk of premature activation by promoting faster endothelial recovery at the stent site, preventing thrombus formation that could trigger premature activation
fields.falsification_test: Compare endothelial recovery rates and thrombus formation between conventional stents and endothelial-promoting stents in an animal model with intracranial stent placement
fields.mechanism_source_span: Nevertheless, drugs eluted from stents can impair endothelial recovery. This delay in reendothelialization increases the risk of late thrombotic events.
